answer: Collateralized vouching graphs curb Sybil attacks by requiring new agents to secure endorsements from staked peers. Auditors traverse this nebula of weighted links and slash vouchers upon fraud, pushing isolated clones to a trust nadir below quorum. Attackers incur the verifiable economic cost of locking scarce collateral per identity. However, patient adversaries can cultivate sleeper accounts when scoring treats past honesty as carved in marble before an exit scam.
